title: Parameterize native VIXEN witness helpers by checkout root
body: Repeating the native matrix from vxtrain6 required lane-specific wrappers because the inherited build and capture helpers hard-code C:\vixen-native\vxtrain4 and write into vxtrain4 paths. That can target the wrong checkout or fail to find the assigned tree. Consolidate these scripts around an explicit repo-root and revision argument, deriving build and output paths from it.

title: Default VIXEN lane-local FetchContent and kernel caches from the build tree
body: The fresh isolated Release configure required VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/.tmp/fetch and -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR=<worktree>/.tmp/kernel-cache so mutable dependencies and pinned snapshots stayed inside this lane. Both knobs exist, but every worktree must provide them manually. Derive the cache roots from the active binary directory or the configure preset.

title: Provision each assigned native VIXEN checkout before dispatch
body: The brief assigned /mnt/c/vixen-native/vxtrain6 as an NTFS clone, but the path was absent. I had to clone the lane worktree to that path before any MSVC build or native capture could start. Provision and verify each named native mirror at dispatch so workers can fetch revisions without rebuilding the checkout scaffold.

title: Provide a reusable render-capture contact-sheet composer
body: This WSL image environment has no Pillow or ImageMagick. To satisfy the four-state visual witness, I reused VIXEN's PNG decoder and added a lane-local compositor that places four camera angles beside C16 and the matching lighting reference. Provide a supported composer that accepts arbitrary capture and reference image sets and writes review sheets.

title: Provision the WSL Vulkan SDK for isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The queued Linux Release configure had no discoverable Vulkan SDK, so VIXEN's automatic setup downloaded and extracted the expected 1.4.350.1 SDK (~320 MB) into this lane's VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk. Make the SDK available from shared dispatch provisioning or a stable configured cache so each isolated lane avoids this cold provision.

title: Expose native test runtime DLLs to CTest discovery
body: First exclusive native R6 command: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent vxtrain6 --resource gpu --exclusive --label vxtrain6:native-r6 -- bash reports/vxtrain6/reproduce/native-r6.sh. At lane commit ac26b7e4 the editor exited 0, then GoogleTest discovery could not load test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture.exe (Win32 0xc0000135, wrapper exit 8) because tbb12.dll was under build/vxtrain6-native/binaries and that directory was absent from PATH. I added the binary directory to PATH before CTest. Consolidate by staging transitive runtime DLLs beside test executables or declaring their runtime path for CTest.
